# The Productivity Bond Model
A sovereign debt instrument linked to productivity gains.
- Formal definition: https://traffictorch.github.io/productivity-bond-model/#model-definition
- Simulator: https://traffictorch.github.io/productivity-bond-model/#simulator
- Full book PDF: https://traffictorch.github.io/productivity-bond-model/book/The_Infinite_Debt_Problem.pdf
- Repository: https://github.com/traffictorch/productivity-bond-model
